name: Quick Jab
description: A lightning-fast baseline strike that costs no momentum, allowing the user to seamlessly transition into remaining movement.

name: Shield Prod
description: Deals minor blunt damage and nudges an adjacent target 1 tile back to clear an escape lane. Unless there is no room.

name: Hamstring Cut
description: A shallow blade stroke aimed at the legs, applying a minor 1-turn movement reduction.

name: Step-Aside Strike
description: Strikes the target and automatically forces the user to step 1 tile diagonally backward (if possible), breaking contact.

name: Feinting Lunge
description: A deceptive thrust that lowers the target's physical evasion stat for the duration of the current turn.

name: Dirty Sand Kick
description: Kicks ground debris into the target's eyes, dealing token damage and inflicting a mild accuracy penalty.

name: Grip Loosen
description: Targets the enemy's weapon arms, slightly decreasing their outgoing physical damage for 1 turn.

name: Crescent Strike
description: A heavy attack that always does consistent high damage.

name: Pity Pity
description: Use on a weak target if you want them to stay living.

name: Hop
description: Allows the unit to move 1 space forward ignoring terrain height.

name: Wild Swing
description: A haymaker thrown with eyes shut. Anything can happen. Its damage varies wildly: 50% to 170% of normal.

name: Bonk
description: A clumsy knock that sends the foe back a step and rattles the user too. The user takes 5% of max HP in recoil.

name: Rending Cut
description: A cut that opens the target's guard. Exposed (25% more damage) for 2 turns.

name: Shoulder Barge
description: Drive a shoulder in and shove the foe two tiles.

name: Twin Strike
description: Two quick blows in one motion. Strikes 2 times.

name: Rallying Blow
description: A strike that fires the user up. The user Attack +10% for 2 turns.

name: Pin Down
description: Pin a foot to the ground. Rooted (cannot walk) for 1 turn.

name: Cartwheel Slash
description: A flailing cartwheel that hits whatever is near the target. Nobody knows how it works. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Its damage varies wildly: 40% to 220% of normal.

name: Cleaver of Ruin
description: A finishing chop that loves a wounded target. +40% damage on a target at 30% HP or less.

name: Vampiric Slash
description: A cut that drinks. The user regains 40% of the damage dealt.

name: Reckless Charge
description: All power, no guard. The user takes 8% of max HP in recoil.

name: Crippling Blow
description: Smash a joint and sap the arm. Weakened (less physical damage) for 2 turns.

name: Hooked Haul
description: A hooked blade that drags the foe in. Drags the target 2 tiles toward the user.

name: Tavern Brawl
description: Chairs, fists and a flung mug. Strikes 2 times. 50% chance: Blinded for 2 turns.

name: Stunning Blow
description: A blow to the head. 50% chance to stun. 50% chance: Stunned (loses its next turn) for 1 turn.

name: Hammer Slam
description: A colossal blow that shakes the ground round it. 40% chance to stun each. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. 40% chance: Stunned (loses its next turn) for 1 turn.

name: Executioner's Cut
description: No mercy for the wounded. +60% damage on a target at 30% HP or less.

name: Whirlwind
description: Spin through everyone around the aimed tile, friend or foe. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one.

name: Iron Rain
description: Three heavy blows in a blink. Strikes 3 times.

name: Barrel Roll
description: Roll a barrel through the foe. It does not care who is in the way.

name: Blade Storm
description: A whirl of steel that hits three times around the aimed tile. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Strikes 3 times.

name: Last Stand
description: The nearer to death, the harder the hit. Up to +80% damage as the user's HP runs out.

name: Shatter Guard
description: Break armour and nerve alike. Exposed (25% more damage) for 3 turns. Defense -20% for 3 turns.

name: Sundering Blow
description: A blow that breaks the target's defences. Exposed (25% more damage) for 3 turns. Defense -30% for 3 turns.

name: Thousand Cuts
description: Five strikes before the target can blink. Strikes 5 times.
